# Authentication and authorization (`AUTH`)

Proving who a user is, and deciding what that user may do.

**Spec status:** specified

## Requirements

### REQ-AUTH-001

The system shall authenticate a user by email address and password, and shall issue a session that identifies that user on subsequent requests.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-001-1` | a registered member with a known password | they sign in with that email and password | a session is issued and requests carrying it are attributed to that member |
| `AC-AUTH-001-2` | a registered member | they sign in with the wrong password | the request is rejected with error INVALID_CREDENTIALS and no session is issued |
| `AC-AUTH-001-3` | an email address with no account | someone signs in with it | the request is rejected with error INVALID_CREDENTIALS, worded identically to a wrong password |

### REQ-AUTH-002

The system shall store passwords only as a salted hash, and shall never return a password or its hash in any response.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-002-1` | a member who has just set a password | the stored record is inspected | it holds a salted hash and not the password |
| `AC-AUTH-002-2` | any endpoint that returns a user record | it is called by any role | the response carries no password and no hash field |

### REQ-AUTH-003

The system shall lock an account for 15 minutes after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts, and shall reject sign-in for that account while it is locked even when the password is correct.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-003-1` | an account with four consecutive failed attempts | a fifth attempt fails | the account is locked and the response carries error ACCOUNT_LOCKED |
| `AC-AUTH-003-2` | a locked account | the correct password is supplied within the 15 minutes | the request is rejected with error ACCOUNT_LOCKED |
| `AC-AUTH-003-3` | an account with four consecutive failed attempts | a fifth attempt succeeds | the session is issued and the failed count returns to zero |

### REQ-AUTH-004

The system shall assign every user exactly one of the roles member, librarian or administrator, and shall refuse any request whose role does not permit the operation.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-004-1` | a user with the role member | they attempt to add a title to the catalogue | the request is rejected with error FORBIDDEN and the catalogue is unchanged |
| `AC-AUTH-004-2` | a user with the role librarian | they add a title to the catalogue | the title is added |
| `AC-AUTH-004-3` | a user with the role librarian | they attempt to change another user's role | the request is rejected with error FORBIDDEN |
| `AC-AUTH-004-4` | a user with the role administrator | they change another user's role | the role is changed |

### REQ-AUTH-005

The system shall end a session when the user signs out, and shall expire a session that has been idle for 30 days.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-005-1` | a signed-in member | they sign out and then reuse the session | the request is rejected with error SESSION_INVALID |
| `AC-AUTH-005-2` | a session unused for 30 days | it is presented | the request is rejected with error SESSION_EXPIRED |

### REQ-AUTH-006

The system shall record every sign-in, sign-out and role change with the acting user, the affected user and the time, and shall retain those records for two years.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-AUTH-006-1` | an administrator changing a member to librarian | the change is made | a record names the administrator, the member, the old role, the new role and the time |
| `AC-AUTH-006-2` | an audit record written two years ago less a day | retention runs | the record is still present |
